title: Sri Suktam Meaning in English: How to Chant It for Lakshmi's Blessings
intro: Sri Suktam is one of the oldest hymns to Goddess Lakshmi and is chanted in many homes on Fridays. Knowing what the words mean makes the chanting more meaningful, so here is a simple look at the first two verses.

p: Sri Suktam is a khila sukta, a supplementary hymn attached to the Rig Veda. It prays to Agni, called Jatavedas, to bring Goddess Lakshmi to the devotee.
Shri means wealth, beauty and auspiciousness. In this hymn it covers health, grain, cattle, good relationships and peace of mind, not only money.
Hiranya-varnam harinim suvarna-rajata-srajam | Chandram hiranmayim lakshmim jatavedo ma avaha ||
Meaning: O Agni, please bring to me Lakshmi, who shines with a golden glow, who is graceful like a deer, who wears garlands of gold and silver, and who is as gentle as the moon.
Tam ma avaha jatavedo lakshmim anapagaminim | Yasyam hiranyam vindeyam gam ashvam purushan aham ||
Meaning: Bring to me that Lakshmi who never leaves, through whom I may gain gold, cattle, horses and good companions.
The key word is anapagamini, one who does not leave. The prayer is not only to receive wealth, but for wealth that stays.

Another verse says, kshut-pipasamalam jyeshtham alakshmim nashayamyaham, asking for hunger, thirst and misfortune to be removed. Elders read this to mean that a home with food, water, cleanliness and discipline already has the qualities of Lakshmi.
On Friday morning, bathe and tidy the puja space. Light a ghee or oil lamp before a picture of Lakshmi and offer a lotus or red flowers if you can.
If the pronunciation is difficult, listen to a recording first and learn slowly. Sincerity matters more than perfection.

faq.q: Which day is best for Sri Suktam?
faq.a: Any day works. Fridays, full moon days and Diwali are considered especially suitable.

faq.q: How many verses does Sri Suktam have?
faq.a: The count varies slightly between traditions, so follow the text used in your family or by your teacher.
